AI Website Builders

Durable

Durable generates a small-business website in seconds and combines it with lightweight CRM, lead, booking, SEO and marketing tools.

What is Durable?

Durable is an AI-first business and website builder aimed at getting service businesses online with minimal setup. After answering a few questions, users receive an editable, responsive website and can manage supporting tasks such as customer records, leads, bookings, content and discoverability from the same product.

Best for: Solo operators and small service businesses that value speed and built-in business tools more than deep code-level website customization.

Main features

  • AI website generation from a short business brief
  • Drag-and-drop editing
  • Responsive hosting with SSL
  • Built-in CRM and lead management
  • Bookings and business-management tools
  • AI content, image, blog and SEO/GEO tools

Use cases

  • Launch a local service-business website quickly
  • Create a simple lead-generation site
  • Manage contacts and incoming leads
  • Accept bookings and coordinate appointments
  • Generate marketing and blog content

Who is it for?

  • solo founders
  • local service businesses
  • freelancers
  • consultants
  • small business owners

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription

Starting price: USD 22 / month, billed annually; $25/month on monthly billing for Launch

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Very fast initial site generation
  • Free plan supports testing with a Durable subdomain
  • Bundles website, hosting and several small-business tools in one product

Limitations

  • Durable says it is not designed specifically for ecommerce businesses
  • Extensive HTML customization is not offered because the product is no-code
  • Free-plan AI, CRM and branding allowances are limited, and custom-domain use is a paid feature

Frequently asked questions

Is Durable free to use?

Yes. Durable lists a $0 Free plan with a Durable subdomain and limited AI/CRM allowances. Paid plans unlock features such as custom-domain use and broader business tooling.

Is Durable a strong fit for a full ecommerce store?

Not primarily. Durable's own pricing FAQ says the product is not designed specifically for ecommerce businesses, although businesses can still use it alongside commerce workflows.

Can I freely edit a Durable site's HTML?

Not extensively. Durable positions the builder as a no-code product and explicitly says it does not offer extensive HTML customization.
